What I mean is a silent, 6-second widescreen video, with the whole thing done as one shot slowly pushing toward the front door. I always worry that describing camera movement in words makes it sound more complicated than I actually mean. Keep a few trees in the foreground so you can feel the camera moving.

Your cabin video is ready: a 6-second silent widescreen clip (16:9, 480p on the free plan), made as one shot.
